      Party vote, 2022 and 2026

      Blocs. Coalition: Likud, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionism–Zehut, Shas, UTJ and Noam (in 2022: Likud, Religious Zionism, Shas, UTJ). Opposition: Yashar!, Together, The Democrats, Yisrael Beytenu and The Reservists (in 2022: Yesh Atid, National Unity, Yisrael Beytenu, Labor, Meretz). Arab parties: Joint List and Ra'am (in 2022: Ra'am, Hadash-Ta'al, Balad). Everything else, such as Amcha Yisrael or Jewish Home, counts as other.

      Small communities swing widely: a few hundred voters can move tens of points.
